title: Stateful Engine MCP Working Context
description: Rename set_local_kit to start_working_in_local_kit. Introduce start_working_in_design(guid), read_current_design, finish_working_in_design, start_working_in_type(guid), read_current_type, finish_working_in_type, finish_working_in_kit. Update session state to track current kit, design, and type. Update tests.
summary: Renamed set_local_kit to start_working_in_local_kit and made the compose MCP engine stateful. Added session state for designs (_mcp_session_designs) and types (_mcp_session_types) alongside existing kit state. Introduced 8 new MCP tools: start_working_in_design(guid), read_current_design, finish_working_in_design, start_working_in_type(guid), read_current_type, finish_working_in_type, finish_working_in_kit. Made sum_quality_in_design session-aware (uses kit from session). Removed drag_pieces_in_design tool (referenced non-existent dragPiecesInDesignDict). Fixed ASSETS_DIR path in tests. All 77 tests pass.
